scope: Rushab assigned tasks only. No Yogita-owned task is executed or marked complete.
verification_state: Local candidate independently accepted for declared collaboration/operations/OCR-contextual boundaries. Not a deployed/final hosted release.

tasks.task: Backend skeleton, schema and deployed connection
tasks.original_acceptance: API health and database round trip work remotely. Define workspace, sources, asset revisions, runs, findings, comments and approvals. Commit setup instructions.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Local API/database/schema work; remote connection and migration acceptance remain unverified.

tasks.original_acceptance: Create/read/update campaign facts and guidelines with owner confirmation, scope and immutable versions. Pending facts are excluded from authoritative checks. Reload preserves records.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Owner-confirmed versioned source and campaign APIs exercised.

tasks.original_acceptance: Check applicable terms, required wording and scoped price/date values. Store locations and source references; clean examples do not trigger naive numeric conflicts.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Candidate-first exact checks with persisted source/version/span evidence and clean controls.

tasks.original_acceptance: Probe Groq candidate and/or available OpenRouter model on development examples. Record quality/errors/latency; keys stay server-side. Use a bounded schema and timeouts.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Groq openai/gpt-oss-120b authenticated and exercised; measured live latency/errors retained. Quality remains limited.

tasks.task: Retrieval, evidence validation and review API
tasks.original_acceptance: Filter approved sources, include mandatory rules and validate source IDs, versions, quotes and affected spans. Persist genuine results and explicit partial/failed states.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Bounded approved-source retrieval/citation/span validation and snapshot-safe persisted contextual API.

tasks.original_acceptance: Text edits and poster replacements create versions. Comments and decisions persist. Applying an outdated suggestion returns a conflict instead of overwriting newer content.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Versioned caption/poster mutations, comments, append-only decisions, replay/stale conflicts.

tasks.original_acceptance: Enforce permissions on the server. Approval requires current completed checks and resolved/permitted exceptions. Content/source edits stale readiness; history remains. Test concurrent changes.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Server permissions and stale approval invariants. Incomplete checks may receive explicit human manual supplements; never relabelled automated completion.

tasks.task: Image upload, private access and OCR
tasks.original_acceptance: Bound bytes/pixels and reject invalid files. Store safely; OCR returns original dimensions, text, pixel boxes and uncertainty. Unreadable text cannot pass silently.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Private canonical PNG/OCR with byte/pixel/process caps; coordinates match stored normalised image rather than unrotated upload.

tasks.original_acceptance: Reuse rule/evidence pipeline on extracted text. Group mismatches while preserving both locations and applicable source. Preserve currencies, conditions and time zones.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Caption and poster exact checks use same sources; grouped issue links preserve both locations. Arbitrary currencies/conditions/timezones are not solved and unsafe cases abstain.

tasks.original_acceptance: Run page-7 checks, record failures, raw counts and unassessed inputs. Fix blockers. Honour the planned development/held-out split or disclose a reduced evaluation.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: 358 automated tests pass and live API scripts pass. Reduced frozen evaluation: 3 assessed development matches, all 3 heldouts unassessed. Not representative accuracy.

tasks.original_acceptance: Correct scoped conflicts point to approved evidence; valid variation stays unflagged. Verify currency, time zone and offer conditions.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Declared exact grammar/clean controls pass; unrestricted timezone/offer-condition handling is explicitly unsupported.

tasks.original_acceptance: Report insufficient support or clarification. Never invent a quote or call an unsupported claim definitively false.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Missing/pending/expired/conflicting authority produces incomplete/clarification states, not fabricated truth.

tasks.original_acceptance: Unknown IDs, altered quotes and wrong versions are rejected/marked invalid. Corrections do not silently change unrelated facts or qualifiers.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Strict source ID/version/quote/span checks; contextual replacements withheld and exact edits verify spans.

tasks.original_acceptance: Simulate timeout, rate limit, invalid output and restart. Persist failed/partial state; bound retries and avoid stranded “running” jobs.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Mocked timeout/quota/malformed cases and manual stopped-worker recovery tested. No durable queue.

tasks.original_acceptance: Approve, then edit caption, replace poster or change operative facts. Approval history remains but readiness is stale in every case.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Caption/poster/source changes stale approvals; historical records retained.

tasks.original_acceptance: Concurrent edit/approve/readiness checks and a late review run cannot authorise new content. Outdated correction application returns conflict.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Real database concurrency tests, in-flight approval guard and old-suggestion conflict protection.

tasks.original_acceptance: Direct creator approval and cross-workspace read/write/file URLs are denied. Sandbox actor switching cannot reach private data.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: API workspace/file isolation and creator/self-approval denials; not production identity.

tasks.original_acceptance: Instructions inside draft/OCR cannot change authority. Disabling external inference prevents calls and marks affected checks unavailable.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Consent/no-HTTP gates and prompt/provenance validation pass offline. Live adversarial heldout output rejected; no general prompt-injection resistance claim.

tasks.original_acceptance: Verify Python/Tesseract support, database connectivity, persistent files, HTTPS, sleep behaviour and applicable limits. If the host fails, change route before G2.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Backend package prepared; hosting explicitly deferred until account/service selection. No public URL/HTTPS/remote persistence proof.

tasks.original_acceptance: Use server-side secrets, bounded payloads, explicit review, per-session limits and queued inference. Check actual account limits. No paid fallback without consent; no quota circumvention.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Persistent hourly/in-flight provider admission and server-only keys implemented. Durable queue reduced to bounded synchronous admission; actual account token limits not established.

tasks.task: Separate public demo from private data
tasks.original_acceptance: Use isolated fictional sessions with synthetic-data notice. Enforce real authenticated membership for any private workspace. Restrict file access; omit raw content from routine logs.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Isolated synthetic-only demo and private image access. No private-customer workspace support; confidential uploads explicitly prohibited.

tasks.original_acceptance: Record release commit and configuration; exercise migrations/restart, recover a stalled run and prove persistence. Check deletion covers originals/extractions/caches. Keep hosting available for judging.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Wheel/restart/recovery local evidence exists; hosted freeze, migrations and verified deletion/retention remain open.

tasks.original_acceptance: Write architecture, setup, deployed components, exact provider/model and configuration, test results and technical limitations. Verify no secrets in repository/history.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Backend architecture/setup/model/test/limitations/provenance documented. Hosted component evidence depends on deferred D01/D06.

tasks.original_acceptance: Run fresh review, clean case, outage state, approval invalidation and restart/persistence against release candidate. Record commit/time and any known limitations.
tasks.evidence_and_remaining: Local fresh/clean/outage/approval/restart checks exercised; final remote release-candidate smoke depends on hosting.
